name: Raven Report Designer
summary: The report designer of RavenRS Reporting for the people who use the reports: bands, fields, expressions, preview and export to PDF and XLSX, on the desktop and in the browser.
when_to_use: To design or change a report of RavenRS Reporting and see it with data.
To try ravenrs-report-designer in a real app before putting it in your own.

commands.does: Opens the designer with a sample report. Closing the window keeps it beside the clock.
Builds the designer with no window; exit code 0 when it draws.

limits: The web build is made with scripts/build-web.sh raven-report-designer.
